Shop1EnhancePassiveKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/item stats/shop1_items_enhance_passive.txt")
LocalizeVariablesKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/utils/localize_variables.txt")
Shop2ItemsKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/item stats/shop2_items.txt")
Shop3ItemsKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/item stats/shop3_items.txt")
UnitsKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/npc_units_custom.txt")
MonsterStatsKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/monsters/monster_stats.txt") or {}
AutocastDummyKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/units/npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy.txt")
UnitsKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/npc_units_custom.txt")
CareerConfigKV = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/item stats/career_config.txt")

if not GameState then
    GameState = {
        start_time = 0,
        game_start = false,
        game_over_flag = false,
        test = true,
        spawn_points = {},
        walls = {},
    }
end

function GameState:GetGameTime()
    return GameRules:GetGameTime() - GameState.start_time
end

local function InitHeroUiNetTable()
    if not HeroOverrideKV then
        return
    end

    for heroName, kv in pairs(HeroOverrideKV) do
        if type(kv) == "table" then
            local uiImage = kv.UIImage
            local baseHero = kv.override_hero
            if uiImage or baseHero then
                CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("hero_ui", heroName, {
                    ui_image = uiImage,
                    base_hero = baseHero,
                })
            end
        end
    end
end

function barebones:RegisterCustomGameEvent()
    AccountManager:Init()

    -- SendToConsole("dota_camera_disable_zoom 1")

    InitHeroUiNetTable()

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        StatsManager:Update()
        return 0.03
    end)

    HeroHealth:Start()

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("select_difficulty", function(_, keys)
        local pid = keys.PlayerID
        local level = tonumber(keys.level)

        GameRules.selectedDifficulty = level

        -- print("[Difficulty] Player selected: ", level)

        -- 正式开始游戏
        StartCustomGame(level)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("show_difficulty", function(_, keys)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("showDifficultySelect", {})
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop2_manual_refresh", function(_, event)
        Shop2Manager:OnManualRefresh(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop2_buy", function(_, event)
        Shop2Manager:OnBuyRequest(event)
    end)


    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("show_start", function(_, keys)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("showStartGame", {})
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("request_stats", function(_, args)
        local playerID = args.PlayerID or args.player_id
        if not playerID then return end

        StatsManager:PushStatsToUI(playerID)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("request_stats_for_pid", function(_, args)
        local requester = args.PlayerID or args.player_id
        local target_pid = args.target_pid
        if requester == nil or target_pid == nil then return end

        StatsManager:PushStatsToPlayer(tonumber(target_pid), tonumber(requester))
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("trigger_challenge", function(_, keys)
        local id = keys.id
        local pid = keys.PlayerID
        local mgr = SpawnManagers[pid]
        if mgr then
            mgr:TriggerChallenge(id)
        end
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("synthesize", function(_, event)
        -- print("[INPUT][Lua] synthesize RECEIVED", event.PlayerID)
        Shop1Managers[event.PlayerID]:HandleSynthesizeByPID()
    end)

    if IsInToolsMode() then
        -- print("[CustomGame] Registering ToolMode commands")
        require('test_mode')

        Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameToggleStatsUI", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(
                PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid),
                "CustomGameToggleStatsUI",
                {}
            )
        end, "ToolMode Toggle Stats UI", 0)

        -- Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameSynthesize", function()
        --     local pid = 0
        --     if not pid then return end

        --     Shop1Managers[pid]:HandleSynthesizeByPID()
        -- end, "ToolMode Synthesize", 0)

        Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameSummon", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
            if not mgr or not mgr.OnBuyRequest then return end

            mgr:OnBuyRequest({ PlayerID = pid, id = 1 })
        end, "ToolMode Summon", 0)

        Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameEnhance", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnEnhanceRequest then
                Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceRequest({ PlayerID = pid })
            end
        end, "ToolMode Enhance", 0)

        Convars:RegisterCommand("AddItemLevel", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
            if not player then return end

            local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
            if not hero then return end

            Shop1Managers[pid]:AddItemLevel(hero)
        end, "ToolMode AddItemLevel", 0)
    elseif GameState.test then
        require('test_mode')
    end
end

function StartCustomGame(level)
    GameState.game_over_flag = false;
    GameState.game_start = true;

    print("[Game Start]")

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("game_start", {})

    GameState.start_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    InitAllPlayerSpawnManagers()
    SelectionSpecial:Init()
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.Init then
        Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    end

    if IsInToolsMode() then
        for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
            if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
                local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
                if player then
                    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_mouse_bind", {})
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function EndCustomGame(result)
    -- print("[End]", GameState.game_over_flag, GameState.game_start)

    if GameState.game_over_flag then return end
    GameState.game_over_flag = true

    GameState.game_start = false

    print("[Game] EndCustomGame =>", result)

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        ClearAllGroundItems()
        ResetAllHeroes()

        for pid, mgr in pairs(SpawnManagers) do
            if mgr.StopAll then
                mgr:StopAll()
            end
        end

        PlayerStats:Clear()
        StatsManager:Clear()
        PlayerResourceExt:Clear()

        -- 3. 通知 UI
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("game_end", {
            result = result -- "win" / "lose"
        })
    end)
end

function ClearAllGroundItems()
    local drops = Entities:FindAllByClassname("dota_item_drop")

    for _, drop in pairs(drops) do
        if not drop:IsNull() then
            local item = drop:GetContainedItem()
            if item and not item:IsNull() then
                item:RemoveSelf()
            end
            drop:RemoveSelf()
        end
    end
end

function ResetAllHeroes()
    local heroes = HeroList:GetAllHeroes()
    if not heroes then
        return
    end

    local assigned = {}
    local assigned_count = 0
    for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
        if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
            local assigned_hero = player and player:GetAssignedHero() or PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(pid)
            if assigned_hero and not assigned_hero:IsNull() then
                local entid = assigned_hero:entindex()
                if not assigned[entid] then
                    assigned[entid] = true
                    assigned_count = assigned_count + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- print("heros", assigned_count)

    for _, hero in ipairs(heroes) do
        if hero:IsRealHero() and not hero:IsTempestDouble() and not hero:IsClone() then
            local pid = hero:GetPlayerID()
            local heroName = hero:GetUnitName()

            -- print("[Shop1Managers]", pid, Shop1Managers, Shop1Managers[pid], hero, hero:GetUnitName())
            Shop1Managers[pid]:DestroyAllItems(hero)

            for i = 0, hero:GetAbilityCount() - 1 do
                local ability = hero:GetAbilityByIndex(i)
                if ability then
                    hero:RemoveAbilityByHandle(ability)
                end
            end

            local modifiers = hero:FindAllModifiers()
            for _, mod in pairs(modifiers) do
                mod:Destroy()
            end

            hero:Stop()

            -- 2. 关闭自动攻击
            hero:SetIdleAcquire(false)
            hero:SetAcquisitionRange(0)

            -- 3. 清空当前攻击目标
            hero:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)

            -- 4. 直接 Kill（非常重要）
            hero:ForceKill(false)

            local newHero = PlayerResource:ReplaceHeroWith(pid, heroName, 0, 0)

            Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
                if newHero and not newHero:IsNull() then
                    local spawn = PlayerSpawnPoint[pid]
                    if spawn then
                        local pos = spawn:GetOrigin()
                        FindClearSpaceForUnit(newHero, pos, true)
                        -- print("Respawn", pos)
                        newHero:SetOrigin(pos)
                    end

                    newHero:Stop()
                    if SpawnWallManager and SpawnWallManager.ResetPlayer then
                        SpawnWallManager:ResetPlayer(pid, newHero)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        local keep = {}
        for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do

if Shop1Manager == nil then
    Shop1Manager = class({})
end

Shop1Managers = {}

Shop1Manager._event_registered = Shop1Manager._event_registered or false

Shop1Managers.debug = Shop1Managers.debug or false
Shop1Managers.motion_debug = Shop1Managers.motion_debug or false

Shop1Managers.level_map = { [1] = 1, [2] = 10, [3] = 20, [4] = 30 }
require("spawn_wall_manager")

local function GetShop1ItemKV(name)
    if not name or not Shop1ItemsKV then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name]
    if not kv and Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"] then
        kv = Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"][name]
    end
    return kv
end

local function NormalizeCareer(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" or s == "none" then
        return nil
    end
    return s
end

local function IsSupportCareer(career)
    return career and string.lower(career) == "support"
end

function Shop1Managers:InitPlayer(pid)
    local mgr
    if not Shop1Managers[pid] then
        mgr = Shop1Manager()
        mgr.pid = pid
        Shop1Managers[pid] = mgr
    end

    mgr = Shop1Managers[pid]


    if not mgr.Slots then
        mgr.Slots = {}
    end

    for key, entindex in pairs(GameState.spawn_points[pid].good) do
        mgr.Slots[key] = -1
    end


    mgr:Start()
end

function Shop1Manager:Start()
    local raw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/shop config/shop1.txt")

    if not raw then
        return
    end

    -- 兼容两种写法："ShopItems" 根 或者直接是条目
    local kv = raw.ShopItems or raw

    self:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self:BuildEquipPool()
    self:RegisterShopEvents()
    self:SyncToClient()
end

function Shop1Manager:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self.items = {}

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    for idStr, data in pairs(kv) do
        local id = tonumber(idStr)
        if id then
            local base_price   = tonumber(data.price) or 0
            local price_factor = tonumber(data.price_factor) or 1.0
            local unlock_delay = tonumber(data.unlock_time) or 0
            local grade        = tonumber(data.grade) or 1
            local name         = data.name or ""

            local price_table  = {}
            if data.price_table then
                for key, value in pairs(data.price_table) do
                    price_table[tonumber(key)] = tonumber(value)
                end
            end

            self.items[id] = {
                base_price   = base_price,         -- 初始价格
                price_factor = price_factor,       -- 价格倍率
                unlock_time  = now + unlock_delay, -- 解锁时间
                unlock_delay = unlock_delay,
                grade        = grade,              -- 商品等级（装备等级）
                buy_count    = 0,                  -- 已购买次数
                name         = name,
                price_table  = price_table
            }
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:BuildEquipPool()
    self.equip_pool = {}

    local added = {}

    if AbilityKV then
        for name, data in pairs(AbilityKV) do
            if type(data) == "table"
                and data.Shop == 1
                and data.Open == 1 then
                if not added[name] then
                    table.insert(self.equip_pool, name)
                    added[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RegisterShopEvents()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop_buy_request",
        function(_, keys) self:OnBuyRequest(keys) end
    )
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop1_click_select",
        function(_, keys) self:OnClickSelect(keys) end
    )
end

function Shop1Managers:DebugLog(...)
    if self.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:MotionLog(...)
    if self.motion_debug then
        print("[Shop1Motion]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(lvl)
    return self.level_map[lvl] or 1
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 当前价格（带购买次数和倍率）
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 同步数据到客户端 UI
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:SyncToClient()
    local data_items = {}

    for id, cfg in pairs(self.items) do
        data_items[id] = {
            price        = self:GetCurrentPrice(id),
            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,
            unlock_delay = cfg.unlock_delay,
            grade        = cfg.grade,     -- 商品等级（装备等级）
            level        = cfg.buy_count, -- 用作 UI 显示“购买次数”的话
            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetClientState then
        data.enhance = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(self.pid)
    end

    local pid = self.pid

    if pid then
        local p = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
        if p then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(p, "shop_data_update", data)
        end
        return
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("shop_data_update", data)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 购买请求
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备
    -----------------------------------------------------
    if #self.equip_pool == 0 then
        print("[Shop] WARNING: equip_pool is empty")
        return
    end

    local equip_name = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 装备等级 = 商品等级（从配置拿，不再依赖 JS 传）
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local grade = cfg.grade or 1
    grade = math.max(1, math.min(4, grade))
    local lvl = tonumber(grade)

    self:AddItem(hero, equip_name, lvl, nil, true, nil, true)

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 同步 UI & 日志
    -----------------------------------------------------
    self:SyncToClient()

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop_buy_success", {
        id    = id,
        level = cfg.buy_count, -- UI 如果还在显示 level，就当作“购买次数”
    })

    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop] Player %d bought slot %d -> %s (grade=%d, price=%d, next_price=%d)",
    --     pid, id, equip_name, grade, price, self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    -- ))
end

function Shop1Manager:OnClickSelect(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end
    local x = tonumber(keys.x)
    local y = tonumber(keys.y)
    local z = tonumber(keys.z) or 0
    if not x or not y then
        return
    end
    local pos = Vector(x, y, z)
    self:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, 125)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemRandomly(hero, lvl)
    local equipName = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, lvl, nil, nil, nil, false)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItem(hero, name, lvl, slot, count_recruit, grant_enhance, grant_career_reward, play_synthesize_fx)
    local empty_slots = {}

    if not slot then
        for key, entindex in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if entindex == -1 then
                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end
        end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then
            return
        end

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
        slot = empty_slots[random]
    end

    if not slot then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, no slot", name, lvl)
        return
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, invalid name", name, "slot", slot)
        return
    end

    -- name = "item_invoker_chaos_meteor"
    -- name = "item_drow_ranger_ranged_attack"
    -- name = "item_tiny_toss_tree"
    -- name = "item_crystal_maiden_crystal_nova"

    if grant_enhance == nil then
        grant_enhance = true
    end
    if grant_career_reward == nil then
        grant_career_reward = false
    end

    local final_name = name .. "_" .. lvl
    local ab = hero:FindAbilityByName(final_name)
    if not ab then
        ab = hero:AddAbility(final_name)
    end

    local was_empty = self.Slots and self.Slots[slot] == -1
    if ab then
        ab.raw_name = name
        ab:AddInstance_Shop1({
            level = lvl,
            pid = self.pid,
            slot = slot,
            play_synthesize_fx = play_synthesize_fx == true,
        })
        if count_recruit and was_empty then
            SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(self.pid, hero)
        end
        if grant_career_reward then
            local item_kv = GetShop1ItemKV(name)
            local career = NormalizeCareer(item_kv and item_kv.Career)
            if IsSupportCareer(career) then
                local gold = CareerConfigKV[career].bonus_gold or 0
                PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(self.pid, "gold", gold)
            end
        end
        if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnItemAcquired then
            local changed = Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(self.pid, name, lvl)
            if changed and self.SyncToClient then
                self:SyncToClient()
            end
        end
        if grant_enhance and tonumber(lvl) == 4 and Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.StartSelection then
            local item_source = StripTrailingIndex(name)
            Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
                Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(self.pid, {
                    item_source = item_source,
                    force_unlocked = true,
                })
            end)
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhance()
    for _, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if type(data) == "table" then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() and autocast.RefreshAfterEnhance then
                autocast:RefreshAfterEnhance()
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhanceRebuild()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        return
    end

    local items = {}
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local raw_name = self:GetRawNameFromData(data)
            local level = self:GetDataLevel(data)
            if raw_name and level then
                table.insert(items, {
                    slot = slot,
                    raw_name = raw_name,
                    level = level,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:RemoveItem(item.slot)
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:AddItem(hero, item.raw_name, item.level, item.slot, false, false, false)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    dummy = self:ResolveShop1Dummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, radius)
    if not pos then return end
    local bestEnt = nil

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToPos(data, targetPos, params, onFinish)
    if not data or not targetPos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy_sp = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp or nil

    params = params or self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local maxDuration = tonumber(params.max_duration) or tonumber(params.duration) or 1.0
    local minDuration = tonumber(params.min_duration) or 0
    local maxHeight = tonumber(params.max_height) or tonumber(params.height) or 200
    local steps = tonumber(params.steps) or 30
    local snapDistance = tonumber(params.snap_distance) or 0
    local maxDistance = tonumber(params.max_distance)
    if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = self:GetMaxDragDistance() or 0
    end
    if steps < 1 then steps = 1 end

    local startPos = dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dist = (targetPos - startPos):Length2D()
    if dist <= snapDistance then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    if maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = dist
    end

    local distanceScale = math.min(dist / maxDistance, 1)
    local duration = maxDuration * distanceScale
    if duration < minDuration then
        duration = minDuration
    end
    if duration <= 0.03 then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local stepCount = math.floor(steps * (duration / maxDuration))
    if stepCount < 1 then stepCount = 1 end
    local height = maxHeight * distanceScale

    Shop1Managers:MotionLog("Move", string.format("dist=%.1f", dist), string.format("scale=%.2f", distanceScale),
        string.format("dur=%.2f", duration), string.format("height=%.1f", height), "steps", stepCount)

    local step = 0
    local interval = duration / stepCount

    data.Moving = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        local t = step / stepCount
        if t > 1 then t = 1 end

        local base = startPos + (targetPos - startPos) * t
        local z = startPos.z + (targetPos.z - startPos.z) * t + height * math.sin(math.pi * t)
        local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y, z)

        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(pos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
            main_pos = pos
        end
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end

        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or pos)
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        step = step + 1
        return interval
    end)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevel(hero, lvl)
    if not self.Slots then

    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 4 then

            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()

    local slots = self.Slots

    for slot, data in pairs(slots) do
        if data and data.Autocast ~= -1 then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and autocast.custom_level and autocast.custom_level < 4 then
                local lv = autocast.custom_level
                local unitName = self:GetDummyUnitName(data)
                if unitName then
                    slotInfos[lv] = slotInfos[lv] or {}
                    slotInfos[lv][unitName] = slotInfos[lv][unitName] or {}
                    table.insert(slotInfos[lv][unitName], slot)
                end
            end

    for _, nameMap in pairs(slotInfos) do

            while #points >= 2 do

            end

    end

if Shop1EnhanceManager == nil then
    Shop1EnhanceManager = class({})
end

Shop1EnhanceManager.states = Shop1EnhanceManager.states or {}
Shop1EnhanceManager._event_registered = Shop1EnhanceManager._event_registered or false
Shop1EnhanceManager.source_index = Shop1EnhanceManager.source_index or {}

Shop1EnhanceManager.config = Shop1EnhanceManager.config or {
    choice_count = 3,
    shop_item_id = 2,
}

local function ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = tonumber(s)
    if num then
        return num
    end

    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level, #nums)]
    end

    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level, #strs)]
    end

    return s
end

local function GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
    local weight = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Weight or 1) or 1
    if weight < 0 then
        weight = 0
    end
    if weight > 1000 then
        weight = 1000
    end
    return weight
end

local function PickWeighted(list, weight_fn)
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local total = 0
    for _, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            total = total + w
        end
    end
    if total <= 0 then
        local idx = RandomInt(1, #list)
        return list[idx], idx
    end
    local roll = RandomFloat(0, total)
    local acc = 0
    for i, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            acc = acc + w
            if roll <= acc then
                return name, i
            end
        end
    end
    return list[#list], #list
end

local function ParsePercentValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    local num = string.match(trimmed, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return nil
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return tostring(raw)
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local tokens = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level, #tokens)]
    end

    return s

SELECTION_VERSION = "1.00"

--[[
    Lua-controlled Selection Library by Noya
    
    Installation:
    - "require" this file inside your code in order to add the new API functions to the PlayerResource global
    - Additionally, ensure your game scripts custom_net_tables.txt has a "selection" entry
    - Finally, ensure that you have the following files correctly added and included in your panorama content folder
        selection.xml, and include line on custom_ui_manifest.xml, on layout/custom_game/ folder
        selection folder containing selection.js and selection_filter.js, on /scripts/ folder

    Usage:
    - Functions with unit_args can recieve an Entity Index, a NPC Handle, or a table of each type.
    - Functions with unit can recieve an Entity Index or NPC Handle

    * Create a new selection for the player
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, unit_args)

    * Add units to the current selection of the player
        PlayerResource:AddToSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    
    * Remove units by index from the player selection group
        PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    
    * Returns the list of units by entity index that are selected by the player
        PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)

    * Deselect everything, selecting the main hero (which can be redirected to another entity)
        PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)

    * Get the index of the first selected unit of the player
        PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
    
    * Check if a unit is selected or not by a player, returns bool
        PlayerResource:IsUnitSelected(playerID, unit_args)

    * Force a refresh of the current selection on all players, useful after abilities are removed
        PlayerResource:RefreshSelection()
    
    * Redirects the selection of the main hero to another entity of choice
        PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, unit)
    
    * Redirects the selection of any entity to another entity of choice
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(unit)

    * Use -1 to reset to default
        PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, -1)
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(-1)

    Notes:
    - Enemy units that you don't control can't be added to the selection group of a player
    - This library requires "libraries/timers.lua" to be present in your vscripts directory.

--]]

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_new", {entities = entities})
    end
end 

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:AddToSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_add", {entities = entities})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:RemoveFromSelection(playerID, unit_args)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        local entities = Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_remove", {entities = entities})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:ResetSelection(playerID)
    local player = self:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "selection_reset", {})
    end
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)
    return Selection.entities[playerID] or {}
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
    local selectedEntities = self:GetSelectedEntities(playerID) 
    return selectedEntities and selectedEntities["0"]
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:IsUnitSelected(playerID, unit)
    if not unit then return false end
    local entIndex = type(unit)=="number" and unit or IsValidEntity(unit) and unit:GetEntityIndex()
    if not entIndex then return false end
    
    local selectedEntities = self:GetSelectedEntities(playerID)
    for _,v in pairs(selectedEntities) do
        if v==entIndex then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:RefreshSelection()
    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        FireGameEvent("dota_player_update_selected_unit", {})
    end)
end

function CDOTA_PlayerResource:SetDefaultSelectionEntity(playerID, unit)
    if not unit then unit = -1 end
    local entIndex = type(unit)=="number" and unit or unit:GetEntityIndex()
    local hero = self:GetSelectedHeroEntity(playerID)
    if hero then
        hero:SetSelectionOverride(unit)
    end
end

function CDOTA_BaseNPC:SetSelectionOverride(reselect_unit)
    local unit = self
    local reselectIndex = type(reselect_unit)=="number" and reselect_unit or reselect_unit:GetEntityIndex()

    CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("selection", tostring(unit:GetEntityIndex()), {entity = reselectIndex})
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Internal
------------------------------------------------------------------------

require('libraries/timers')

if not Selection then
    Selection = class({})
end

function Selection:Init()
    Selection.entities = {} --Stores the selected entities of each playerID
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("selection_update", Dynamic_Wrap(Selection, 'OnUpdate'))
end

function Selection:OnUpdate(event)
    local playerID = event.PlayerID
    Selection.entities[playerID] = event.entities

    if Selection.ignore_next and Selection.ignore_next[playerID] then
        Selection.ignore_next[playerID] = nil
        return
    end

    if not Shop1Managers or not Shop1Managers[playerID] then
        return
    end

    local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
    local entities = event.entities or {}
    local proxy_ent = nil
    local entity_count = 0
    for _, entid in pairs(entities) do
        entity_count = entity_count + 1
        local unit_check = EntIndexToHScript(entid)
        if unit_check and not unit_check:IsNull() and unit_check.__shop1_proxy_dummy then
            proxy_ent = entid
        end
    end
    if proxy_ent and entity_count > 1 then
        Selection.ignore_next = Selection.ignore_next or {}
        Selection.ignore_next[playerID] = true
        PlayerResource:NewSelection(playerID, { proxy_ent })

        local unit_proxy = EntIndexToHScript(proxy_ent)
        if unit_proxy and not unit_proxy:IsNull() and mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
            unit_proxy = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit_proxy)
        end
        local slot, data = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_proxy)
        if not slot or not data then
            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
            if player then
                CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", { ability = "" })
            end
            return
        end

        local ability_name = ""
        if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
            local ability = data.Stats:GetAbility()
            if ability then
                ability_name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            end
        end
        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
        if player then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", {
                ability = ability_name
            })
        end
        return
    end
    local ent = entities[1] or entities["0"]
    if not ent then
        for _, v in pairs(entities) do
            ent = v
            break
        end
    end
    if not ent then return end

    local unit = EntIndexToHScript(ent)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then return end

    if mgr.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager] Selection update", playerID, "ent", ent, unit:GetUnitName())
    end
    if mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
        unit = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit)
        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
            return
        end
    end

    local slot, data = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit)
    if not slot or not data then
        if not Selection.last_dummy then Selection.last_dummy = {} end
        Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = nil
        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
        if player then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", { ability = "" })
        end
        return
    end

    Selection.last_dummy = Selection.last_dummy or {}
    local last = Selection.last_dummy[playerID]
    Selection.last_dummy[playerID] = { slot = slot, ent = ent }

    -- When selecting another dummy, keep default behavior (just select new unit).

    local ability_name = ""
    if data.Stats and not data.Stats:IsNull() then
        local ability = data.Stats:GetAbility()
        if ability then
            ability_name = ability:GetAbilityName()
        end
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID)
    if player then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_dummy_selection", {
            ability = ability_name
        })
    end
end

-- Internal function to build an entity index list out of various inputs
function Selection:GetEntIndexListFromTable(unit_args)
    local entities = {}
    if type(unit_args)=="number" then
        table.insert(entities, unit_args) -- Entity Index
    -- Check contents of the table
    elseif type(unit_args)=="table" then
        if unit_args.IsCreature then
            table.insert(entities, unit_args:GetEntityIndex()) -- NPC Handle
        else

**Planning data enrichment for dummy selection**

I'm mapping how to expand shop1_dummy_selection with stats, abilities, and unit name by extracting base and bonus attributes from Shop1ItemsKV using custom helpers in selection.lua, potentially reimplementing unavailable functions from shop1_manager. I'll also assemble the first three abilities for the dummy, deciding whether to source them from the hero or the item data.

**Detailing UI and data flow for dummy row layout and stats**

The shop1 dummy row will mirror the hero stats layout using shared CSS classes and a panel split into left model (1/3) and right content (2/3) with top horizontal attributes and bottom ability icons. Server-side will send unit name, entity index, and computed stats (projectile and bonus attributes) since raw KV isn’t available client-side; abilities come from entity data on client. Hero and dummy rows will unify layout but keep HeroStatsName label visible in hero only. Stats order and parsing will handle projectile fields first, then alphabetically sorted bonus attributes, converting level-based arrays to numeric values.

I'm clarifying stat value scaling—applying percent format to keys like "Health_Pct" and "ProjectileDamageScale" while leaving others raw—and adding helper functions in selection.lua to build a structured ordered stats list sent in the selection event. UI changes will unify Shop1DummyRow with HeroStatsRow layouts, replacing static labels with dynamic creation for bonus attributes, switching ability icons and models to use DOTAScenePanel and DOTAAbilityImage, and updating top_bar.js to handle new event fields and populate stats and abilities accordingly.

**Adding server-side stat computation and event expansion**

I'm implementing helper functions in selection.lua to build ordered dummy stats from item KV, then updating all relevant selection update event sends to include ability, unit name, entity index, and computed stats—ensuring these fields propagate correctly for both normal and proxy selection cases.

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/selection.lua
@@
 require('libraries/timers')
 
 if not Selection then
     Selection = class({})
 end
+
+local function GetShop1ItemKV(name)
+    if not name or not Shop1ItemsKV then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name]
+    if not kv and Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"] then
+        kv = Shop1ItemsKV["Shop1 Items"][name]
+    end
+    return kv
+end
+
+local function GetItemFieldValue(kv, key, level)
+    if not kv or not key then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local raw = kv[key]
+    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
+        return nil
+    end
+    local tokens = ParseStringArray(tostring(raw))
+    if #tokens > 0 then
+        return tokens[math.min(level or 1, #tokens)]
+    end
+    return raw
+end
+
+local function PushStat(list, key, raw)
+    if not list or not key or raw == nil then
+        return
+    end
+    local value = tonumber(raw)
+    if value == nil then
+        value = raw
+    end
+    table.insert(list, {
+        key = key,
+        value = value,
+    })
+end
+
+local function BuildShop1DummyStatsList(raw_name, level)
+    local item_kv = GetShop1ItemKV(raw_name)
+    if not item_kv then
+        return {}
+    end
+    local list = {}
+    PushStat(list, "ProjectileBaseDamage", GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileBaseDamage", level))
+    PushStat(list, "ProjectileDamageScale", GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileDamageScale", level))
+    PushStat(list, "ProjectileInterval", GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileInterval", level))
+    PushStat(list, "ProjectileRange", GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileRange", level))
+
+    local bonus = item_kv.BonusAttribute or {}
+    local keys = {}
+    for key, _ in pairs(bonus) do
+        table.insert(keys, key)
+    end
+    table.sort(keys)
+    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
+        PushStat(list, key, GetItemFieldValue(bonus, key, level))
+    end
+    return list
+end
*** End Patch

    if raw == nil then

        if BpToRatio then

        return num / 10000

    if num > 1 then

end

            if s == "1" or s == "true" or s == "True" then

            end
        end
    end
    return 0
end

local FilterEnemiesByAngle

local function SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
    if not enemies or #enemies == 0 then

    end
    local best = nil
    local best_dist = nil
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do

            if not best or dist < best_dist then

local function SelectEnemyByCareer(profile, enemies, origin)

    end
    enemies = FilterEnemiesByAngle(profile, enemies, origin)
    if not enemies or #enemies == 0 then

        end
        return SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)

        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do

                    best_dist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        return best or enemies[1]

    if career_key == "ranged" then
        local best = nil
        local best_hp = nil
        local best_dist = nil
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do

                if not best or hp > best_hp or (hp == best_hp and dist < best_dist) then

                    best_hp = hp
                    best_dist = dist
                end
            end
        end
        return best or enemies[1]
    end
    return SelectClosestEnemy(enemies, origin)
end

local function ComputeCareerDamageBonus(profile, enemy, origin)
    if not profile or not enemy or enemy:IsNull() then
        return 0, nil, 0
    end
    local career = NormalizeCareer(profile.career)
    if not career then
        return 0, nil, 0
    end
    local cfg = GetCareerConfigTable(career)
    local dist = origin and (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D() or 0
    local is_boss = IsBossUnit(enemy) and 1 or 0
    if not cfg then
        return 0, dist, is_boss
    end
    local bonus = 0
    local career_key = string.lower(career)
    if career_key == "warrior" then
        local range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_range", "BonusRange", "Range", "range" }) or 0
        local pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg, { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if range > 0 and dist <= range then
            bonus = pct
        end
    elseif career_key == "ranged" then
        local min_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_min_range", "BonusMinRange", "MinRange", "min_range" }) or 0
        local max_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_max_range", "BonusMaxRange", "MaxRange", "max_range" }) or 0
        local max_bonus = ReadCareerPct(cfg, { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if max_range > min_range and dist > min_range then
            local t = math.min(1, (dist - min_range) / (max_range - min_range))
            bonus = max_bonus * t
        elseif dist >= max_range and max_range > 0 then

local function ResolveGesture(profile)
    if profile and profile._resolved_gesture then
        return profile._resolved_gesture
    end
    if profile and profile.is_attack then
        return profile.attack_gesture or ACT_DOTA_ATTACK
    end
    local kv = profile and profile.skill_kv or nil
    if not kv then
        return nil
    end
    local anim = kv.AbilityCastAnimation
    if anim and anim ~= "" and anim ~= "ACT_INVALID" then
        local act = _G[anim]
        if act then
            if profile then
                profile._resolved_gesture = act
            end
            return act
        end
    end
    local channel = kv.AbilityChannelAnimation
    if channel and channel ~= "" and channel ~= "ACT_INVALID" then
        local act = _G[channel]
        if act then
            if profile then
                profile._resolved_gesture = act
            end
            return act
        end
    end
    if profile and profile.projectile_name then
        local act = GestureDefaults[profile.projectile_name]
        if act then
            profile._resolved_gesture = act
            return act
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function PlayVisualGesture(parent, gesture, duration, face_pos)
    if not gesture then
        return
    end
    SyncVisualFacing(parent, face_pos)
    local list = GetVisualDummies(parent)
    if (not list or #list == 0) and parent then
        -- fallback to last known list in case formation list was refreshed mid-cast
        list = parent.__shop1_visual_dummies_last
        if (not list or #list == 0) and parent.__shop1_visual_main then
            local main = parent.__shop1_visual_main
            if main and not main:IsNull() then
                list = main.__shop1_visual_dummies_last or main.__shop1_visual_dummies
            end
        end
    end
    local entries = {}
    if list and #list > 0 then
        for _, dummy in ipairs(list) do
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                table.insert(entries, string.format("%s(alive=%s,start=%s)",
                    tostring(dummy:entindex()),
                    tostring(dummy:IsAlive()),
                    tostring(dummy.StartGesture ~= nil)))
            else
                table.insert(entries, "nil_or_null")
            end
        end
    end
    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop1Dummy][Gesture] caster=%s name=%s visuals=%s last=%s main=%s list=%s gesture=%s",
    --     tostring(parent and parent:entindex() or "nil"),
    --     tostring(parent and parent.GetUnitName and parent:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
    --     tostring(list and #list or 0),
    --     tostring(parent and parent.__shop1_visual_dummies_last and #parent.__shop1_visual_dummies_last or 0),
    --     tostring(parent and parent.__shop1_visual_main and
    --         (parent.__shop1_visual_main:IsNull() and "null" or parent.__shop1_visual_main:entindex()) or "nil"),
    --     table.concat(entries, ","),
    --     tostring(gesture)
    -- ))
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return
    end
    for _, dummy in ipairs(list) do
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
            if dummy.RemoveNoDraw then
                dummy:RemoveNoDraw()
            end
            if parent and parent.GetForwardVector and dummy.SetForwardVector then
                dummy:SetForwardVector(parent:GetForwardVector())
            end
            if dummy.StartGesture then
                dummy:StartGesture(gesture)
            end
            if duration and duration > 0 and dummy.FadeGesture then
                Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
                    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                        dummy:FadeGesture(gesture)
                    end
                    return nil
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then

    end
    local owner = self.owner or self.parent
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
        dummy:SetOwner(owner)
        dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    end
    if origin and dummy.SetAbsOrigin then
        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(origin)
    end
    dummy.__autocast_destroying = nil
    dummy:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    dummy:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    if dummy.RemoveNoDraw then
        dummy:RemoveNoDraw()
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_phased") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_rooted") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
    if dummy:HasModifier("modifier_dummy_autocast") then
        dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    end
    if not dummy:HasModifier("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs") then
        dummy:AddNewModifier(dummy, self.ability, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", {
            prevent_death = 1,
        })
    end
    if self then
        self:ApplyDummySpPassives(dummy)
    end
    if self and self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        dummy.__autocast_source_dummy = self.parent:entindex()
    end
    return dummy
end

local function AcquireDummySp(self, origin)
    local pid = -1
    local owner = self.owner or self.parent
    if owner and not owner:IsNull() then
        pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    end

    local category = GetItemCategory(self.ability)
    local pool_key = tostring(pid) .. "_" .. category

    DummySpPools[pool_key] = DummySpPools[pool_key] or {}
    local pool = DummySpPools[pool_key]

    for i = #pool, 1, -1 do
        local dummy = pool[i]
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            table.remove(pool, i)
        end
    end

    for _, dummy in ipairs(pool) do
        if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() and dummy:IsAlive() and not IsUnitBusy(dummy) then
            return PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
        end
    end

    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    local dummy = CreateUnitByName(
        DUMMY_SP_UNIT_NAME,
        origin or owner:GetAbsOrigin(),
        false,
        owner,
        owner,
        owner:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not dummy then
        return nil
    end

    table.insert(pool, dummy)
    return PrepareDummySp(self, dummy, origin)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFakeDeathStateChanged(event_table)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    -- Ensure the event targets this modifier's owner.
    if event_table.entindex ~= self.owner:entindex() then
        return
    end

    local is_dead = event_table.is_dead

    if is_dead == 1 then -- fake death start
        self.is_paused = true

        if self.projectiles then
            for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
                if profile.skill then
                    profile.skill:SetActivated(false)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif is_dead == 0 then -- fake death end
        self.is_paused = false

        if self.projectiles then
            for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
                if profile.skill then
                    profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalInterval(base)
    local s = GetPlayerStats(self.owner)

    if not base or base <= 0 then
        return 0.05
    end

    local pct = 1 + BpToFlat(s.ProjectileCooldown or 0)

    local final = base / pct

    if final < 0.05 then
        final = 0.05
    end

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetHeroProjectileRangeBonus()
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then
        return 0
    end
    local pid = self.owner.GetPlayerOwnerID and self.owner:GetPlayerOwnerID() or -1
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return 0
    end
    if not PlayerStats or not PlayerStats.data or not PlayerStats.data[pid] then
        return 0
    end
    local display = PlayerStats.data[pid].Display
    local final = display and display.game_final
    return (final and final.ProjectileRange) or 0
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalCastRange(base)
    local range = base or 0
    local final = range + self:GetHeroProjectileRangeBonus()

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,
        interval = params.interval,
        range = params.range or 0,
        base_damage = params.base_damage or 0,
        damage_scale = params.damage_scale or 1,
        pure_percent = params.pure_percent or 0,
        lifesteal = params.lifesteal or 0,
        hit_label = hit_label,
        is_attack = is_attack,
        attack_mode = (name == "ranged_attack" and "ranged" or "melee"),
        attack_gesture = ACT_DOTA_ATTACK,
        dummy_mode = (not is_attack and params.dummy_mode) or nil,
        next_cast_time = 0,
        career = params.career,
    }
    -- print("[InitProjectileProfile]", name, params.interval, params.base_damage, params.damage_scale)

    if not profile.is_attack then
        profile.skill = self.parent:AddAbility(name)
        if profile.skill then
            profile.skill:SetLevel(1)
            if params.level and params.level > 1 then
                profile.skill:SetLevel(params.level)
            end
            profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
            profile.skill_kv = profile.skill:GetAbilityKeyValues()
            profile.behavior = ResolveCastBehavior(profile.skill_kv)
            profile.follow_facing = tostring(profile.skill_kv.AutoCastFollowFacing or "") == "1"
            profile.ability_duration = ParseAbilityDuration(profile.skill_kv)
            if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.OnAbilityAdded then
                self.special_handler:OnAbilityAdded(self, profile, profile.skill)
            end
        end
    else
        profile.behavior = "Target"
        self.attack_profile = profile
    end

    table.insert(self.projectiles, profile)
end

    self.follow_timer_handles = self.follow_timer_handles or {}

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFollowFacingThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not profile or not profile.follow_facing then return 0.1 end
    if self.is_paused then return 0.1 end
    if not profile.follow_facing_active then return 0.1 end
    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then return 0.1 end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if profile.follow_facing_end_time and profile.follow_facing_end_time > 0 and now > profile.follow_facing_end_time then
        profile.follow_facing_active = nil
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.skill and not profile.skill:IsInAbilityPhase() and not profile.skill:IsChanneling() then
        local active = self.parent.GetCurrentActiveAbility and self.parent:GetCurrentActiveAbility() or nil
        if not active or active ~= profile.skill then
            profile.follow_facing_active = nil
            return 0.1
        end
    end

    local target = profile.follow_facing_target
    if target and not target:IsNull() then
        profile.follow_facing_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end

    if profile.follow_facing_pos then
        self.parent:FaceTowards(profile.follow_facing_pos)
        SyncVisualFacing(self.parent, profile.follow_facing_pos)
    end
    return 0.03
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:SpawnCloneAndCast(profile, enemy, pos, interval)
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return nil end
    if not profile then return nil end
    if profile.is_attack and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Target" and (not enemy or enemy:IsNull()) then return nil end
    if profile.behavior == "Position" and not pos then return nil end

    local clone = self:EnsureCloneUnit()

    if not clone then return nil end

    local move_clone = profile.dummy_mode == "clone"
    if move_clone then
        local final_pos = pos or (enemy and enemy:GetAbsOrigin()) or self.owner:GetAbsOrigin()
        clone:SetAbsOrigin(final_pos)
    end
    if pos and not move_clone then
        clone:SetCursorPosition(pos)
        clone:FaceTowards(pos)
    elseif enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
        clone:FaceTowards(enemy:GetAbsOrigin())
    end
    self:ActivateClone()
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    DebugClone("[CloneCast] name", profile.projectile_name, "mode", tostring(profile.dummy_mode), "move_clone",
        move_clone)

    if profile.is_attack then
        local use_projectile = (profile.attack_mode == "ranged")
        local clone_pos = clone:GetAbsOrigin()
        local enemy_pos = enemy:GetAbsOrigin()
        local dist = (enemy_pos - clone_pos):Length2D()
        local atk_range = clone:Script_GetAttackRange()
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack]", clone:GetUnitName(), "Time", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "Distance", dist, "AtkRange",
            atk_range)
        local attrs_mod = self.clone_attrs_mod
        if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            attrs_mod = clone:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
            self.clone_attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
        if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
            autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackSpeedOverride(attrs_mod, clone, self.parent, interval)
        end
        if clone.RemoveGesture then
            clone:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)
        end
        if clone.StartGesture then
            clone:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_ATTACK)
        end
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET,
            TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
            Queue = false,
        })
        -- clone:PerformAttack(
        --     enemy,
        --     true,           -- bUseCastAttackOrb
        --     true,           -- bProcessProcs
        --     true,           -- bSkipCooldown
        --     false,          -- bIgnoreInvis
        --     use_projectile, -- bUseProjectile
        --     false,          -- bFakeAttack
        --     true            -- bNeverMiss
        -- )
        DebugClone("[PerformAttack] After", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "IsAttacking",
            clone.IsAttacking and clone:IsAttacking())
    else
        local ab = clone:FindAbilityByName(profile.projectile_name)
        if not ab then
            ab = clone:AddAbility(profile.projectile_name)
            if ab then
                ab:SetLevel(1)
                ab:SetActivated(true)
            end
        end
        if not ab then
            return nil
        end
        if profile.behavior == "Position" or profile.behavior == "Target" then
            local desired_range = self:GetSearchRange(profile)
            self:UpdateCasterCastRange(profile, desired_range, clone)
        end

        if self.special_handler and self.special_handler.TakeoverCast then
            local order_type = nil
            if profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
                order_type = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET
            elseif profile.behavior == "Self" then
                order_type = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET
            elseif profile.behavior == "Position" then
                order_type = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION
            elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
                order_type = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET
            end
            if order_type then
                local handled, delay = self.special_handler:TakeoverCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, clone, ab, order_type)
                if handled then
                    return clone, delay
                end
            end
        end

        if profile.behavior == "NoTarget" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Self" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = self.owner:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Position" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                Position = pos,
                Queue = false,
            })
        elseif profile.behavior == "Target" then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = clone:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ab:entindex(),
                TargetIndex = enemy:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end

    if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
        local ttl = 0
        if profile.skill and profile.skill.GetSpecialValueFor then
            local dur = profile.skill:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
            if dur and dur > 0 then
                ttl = dur
            end
        end
        if ttl <= 0 then
            ttl = math.max(interval or 0, 0.2)
        end
        self.clone_pause_until = math.max(self.clone_pause_until or 0, GameRules:GetGameTime() + ttl)
        self:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    end

    return clone
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:StartProjectileTimers()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.projectiles or #self.projectiles == 0 then return end

    self.timer_handles = self.timer_handles or {}

    for idx, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        local offset = 0
        local id = Timers:CreateTimer(offset, function()
            return self:OnProjectileThink(profile)
        end)
        table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
        self:StartFollowFacingTimer(profile)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnProjectileThink(profile)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if self.is_paused then
        return 0.1
    end
    if self.parent and self.parent.__autocast_destroying then
        return 0.1
    end
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    if not profile then
        return 0.1
    end

    profile.career_damage_bonus_pct = 1
    profile.career_damage_bonus_dist = nil
    profile.career_damage_bonus_is_boss = 0
    profile.career_damage_bonus_target = nil

    if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    if (not profile.is_attack and not profile.skill) or (not self.owner) or (self.owner:IsNull()) then
        return 0.1
    end

    if profile.next_cast_time and profile.next_cast_time > now then
        return math.max(0.05, profile.next_cast_time - now)
    end

    if HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now) then
        return 0.05
    end

local M = {}

local default_stats = {}

function M.HasBehavior(behavior, flag)
    return behavior and string.find(behavior, flag, 1, true)
end

function M.ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
        return "Position"
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
        local target_team = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
        if M.HasBehavior(target_team, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY") then
            return "Self"
        end
        return "Target"
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        return "NoTarget"
    end

    return "NoTarget"
end

function M.ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv, level)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local nums = ParseArray(cast_range)
        if #nums > 0 then
            local idx = math.max(level or 1, 1)
            idx = math.min(idx, #nums)
            return tonumber(nums[idx]) or 0
        end
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

function M.ParseAbilityDuration(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local dur = ability_kv.AbilityDuration
    if type(dur) == "number" then
        return dur
    end
    if type(dur) == "string" and dur ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(dur, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

function M.GetAbilityCastRange(profile, pos, owner)
    if not profile or not profile.skill then
        return 0
    end
    local ability = profile.skill
    local level = 1
    if ability.GetLevel then
        level = math.max(ability:GetLevel(), 1)
    end
    return M.ParseAbilityCastRange(profile.skill_kv or ability:GetAbilityKeyValues(), level)
end

function M.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, use_direct_cast)
    if not parent or not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local ability_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues() or {}
    local behavior = ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_TOGGLE") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "TOGGLE") then
        ability:ToggleAbility()
        return
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AUTOCAST") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "AUTOCAST") then
        if not ability:GetAutoCastState() then
            ability:ToggleAutoCast()
        end
        return
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "NO_TARGET") then
        if use_direct_cast then
            parent:CastAbilityNoTarget(ability, parent:GetPlayerID())
        else
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = parent:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end
end

function M.IsUnitBusy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if unit.__tiny_grab_busy then
        return true
    end

    local function IsFreezingFieldWithScepterActive()
        if not unit.GetCurrentActiveAbility or not unit.HasModifier then
            return false
        end

        local ability = unit:GetCurrentActiveAbility()
        if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "crystal_maiden_freezing_field" then
            return false
        end

        -- Aghanim allows full action during channel
        return unit:HasModifier("modifier_item_ultimate_scepter")
    end

    -- Channeling normally blocks everything
    if unit.IsChanneling and unit:IsChanneling() then
        if not IsFreezingFieldWithScepterActive() then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- CastPoint (ability windup) always blocks
    if unit.IsCastingAbility and unit:IsCastingAbility() then
        return true
    end

    -- AttackPoint (attack windup) blocks
    if unit.IsAttacking and unit:IsAttacking() then
        if unit.IsPerformingAttack and unit:IsPerformingAttack() then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end


function M.GetPlayerStats(owner)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or (not owner:IsRealHero()) then
        return default_stats
    end

    local pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return default_stats
    end

    local stats = PlayerStats and PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid) or nil
    if not stats then
        return default_stats
    end

    return PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
end

function M.NormalizeName(value)
    if value and value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then
        return value
    end
    return nil
end

function M.ToNumber(value)
    if value == nil or value == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(value)
end

return M

payload.message:
Implemented the dedicated Shop1 dummy UI per your diagram and wired all required data/logic from the server.

What changed
- Shop1 dummy row now uses a separate layout (not shared with hero) with model, name, attack value, career, projectile name, cooldown, description, and 3 ability icons in `content/dzsj/panorama/layout/custom_game/top_bar.xml`.
- New Shop1 dummy styles added in `content/dzsj/panorama/styles/custom_game/top_bar.css`.
- Client logic updated to populate the new fields, compute display text, and keep ability tooltips in `content/dzsj/panorama/scripts/custom_game/top_bar.js`.
- Server payload now includes computed values for attack, cooldown, projectile name, career icon, description token and vars in `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/selection.lua`.

Key behaviors implemented
- Attack value = `hero Attack * (ProjectileDamageScale/10000) + hero ProjectileDamageFlat + dummy ProjectileBaseDamage`.
- Career icon uses `scripts/npc/utils/icon.txt`; career text uses localization `#Warrior/#Ranged/...`.
- Projectile name localized as `#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_<ProjectileName>`, with hero prefix for `attack/ranged_attack`.
- Cooldown uses `modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalInterval` logic (with `ProjectileCooldown` from PlayerStats).
- Description uses `#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_<item>_<level>_Description` with dialog vars `ProjectileRange` and `ProjectileDamageScale`.

Paths updated
- `content/dzsj/panorama/layout/custom_game/top_bar.xml`
- `content/dzsj/panorama/styles/custom_game/top_bar.css`
- `content/dzsj/panorama/scripts/custom_game/top_bar.js`
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/libraries/selection.lua`

Next steps
1) Select a shop1 dummy and verify the name, attack, career, projectile name, cooldown, description, and ability tooltips render as expected.  
2) If any description variables are not substituted correctly, tell me the specific dummy/item and I’ll adjust the dialog variables.

**Evaluating centering issues with multiple rows**

The alignment problem arises from conflicting flow-children and width settings on the top bar rows, requiring a careful combination of fixed widths and horizontal alignment to correctly center the Shop1DummyRow without breaking layout when the hero row is also shown.

**Centering dummy row by ignoring flow and checking localization variables**

Setting Shop1DummyRow to ignore parent flow and horizontally center will align it if shown alone, assuming hero stats row is hidden; meanwhile, dialog variable substitution issues likely stem from case-sensitive keys or missing SetDialogVariable calls, prompting a search for exact token casing in localization files.

**Planning container structure and layout sizes**

I'm defining two containers: one wrapping the model frame and another for the name label with Shop1DummyModelBox and Shop1DummyNameBox components, centering the label via CSS. For abilities, I'll position a 510x200 overlay panel absolutely with individual 60x60 icons spaced by 10 pixels at specified x coordinates, adjusting margins to align and slightly overlap the bottom and top as per design guidance.

**Refining ability alignment and overlay behavior**

I'm finalizing Shop1DummyAbilities width at 200 to fit three 60px icons plus gaps, aligning the right edge with the panel's right side using horizontal alignment and zero right margin. I'll offset icons vertically with negative bottom margin to overlap below the panel while anchoring the overlay to the row center, keeping hit testing enabled for tooltips. Next, I'll update CSS and fix projectile name display in JS before patching.

Also found width issues with row boxes needing `width:100%` to avoid bottom width mismatches. Overlay alignment is off since it's sibling to Shop1DummyRow within a container causing misalignment; reconsider anchoring overlay inside Shop1DummyRight or adjusting overflow on TopBarExtraRow to prevent clipping while enabling correct alignment.

Decided to move overlay inside Shop1DummyRow as a sibling to Shop1DummyPanel to align with Shop1DummyRight’s edge, leveraging `overflow: noclip` on Shop1DummyRow and Shop1DummyPanel to prevent clipping and allow bottom overhang. Also updating image path normalization to correctly handle `.vsvg` and `.vsvg_c` extensions without appending `.vtex`, ensuring s2r paths reflect appropriate extensions and prefixes. Additionally, row and bottom widths get CSS fixes with full 100% widths to resolve layout mismatches.

name: dota2-panorama
description: Dota 2 Panorama UI authoring and maintenance. Use when creating or modifying Panorama layout (VXML), styles (VCSS), or scripts (VJS), wiring CustomUIElement entries, or integrating GameEvents/CustomNetTables/localization in any Dota 2 custom game UI.
